_comment: Cancel DT/DT+ fungus-style features in glimmering_weald so only our dtquark:glow_shroom populates (when DT+ is loaded).
Kill every vanilla/Quark tree feature (type=tree) across all biomes so DT species populators own placement.

Kill vanilla rooted azalea (type=rooted_tree) in lush caves so only dtquark:azalea spawns via our cave_rooted override. Without this, vanilla's rooted azalea tree feature runs in parallel with DT's cave_rooted, producing mixed vanilla + DT azaleas.

Cancel Terralith's native tree features across all terralith biomes as a fallback for setups without DTTerralith. DTTerralith's own cancellers already do this when it is loaded; duplicate cancellation is harmless.
